briefs.body:
# Market brief — Monday 2026-10-26 7:30 ET

## Calendar — next 5 market days (chronological)

**Mon 2026-10-26**
- no major prints

**Tue 2026-10-27**
- 08:30 ET — Durable Goods Orders — manufacturing activity signal
- 10:00 ET — Consumer Confidence — household sentiment read

**Wed 2026-10-28**
- 14:00 ET — FOMC rate decision — hold expected, no SEP
- 14:30 ET — Powell press conference — policy path guidance

**Thu 2026-10-29**
- 08:30 ET — Advance Q3 GDP — growth pulse
- 08:30 ET — Sep PCE / Core PCE — Fed preferred inflation
- 08:30 ET — Initial Jobless Claims — labor tightness

**Fri 2026-10-30**
- 08:30 ET — Employment Cost Index Q3 — wage pressures
- 09:45 ET — Chicago PMI — regional manufacturing

No OPEX this window; next monthly November 20.

## Stock / catalysts — next 30 days

**2026-11-09** — ASTS — Q3 2026 earnings AMC — estimated — MarketBeat/Zacks
**2026-11-12** — TMC — Q3 2026 earnings AMC — estimated — MarketBeat/Zacks

ASTS: no firm launch NET published in 30d; trade reports indicate BB14-16 shipped toward Cape for possible late-October/early-November Falcon 9 window (inferred).
TMC: no dated operational, ISA, NOAA, or Korea Zinc events found in 30d.

No published US-China, critical-minerals, ISA, or FCC spectrum meetings with agenda link in the window.

## Insiders — recently reported (ASTS, TMC)

ASTS: Maya Bernal (Chief Accounting Officer) tax withhold (F) 3,935 Class A shares at $40.66 on Oct 17 (filed Oct 19), remaining direct 128,514. No open-market purchases or sales in the last 14 days.
TMC: no Form 4/144 in last 14d.

## Rates and bonds

10y ~4.98% (little changed overnight), 2y ~4.69%, 10y–2y spread ~+29 bp (not inverted). 5y TIPS/breakeven not sourceable this morning; 5y/10y nominals imply sticky inflation. Growth remains solid while inflation is elevated; Fed hold priced at >90% for Wednesday.

## USD/JPY

Spot ~157.15, +0.2% overnight, still near recent highs. No fresh intervention or BoJ chatter this morning; US yields the main driver.

## Equities tape

SPX closed Friday 7,623.68 (-0.52% from prior), overnight futures +0.1–0.3%. QQQ roughly flat, IWM modestly higher. ATH distance not cleanly available; VIX ~19.5, contained elevated regime. Breadth/% above 50d not available overnight; equal-weight lagged in recent sessions.

## Names / themes only if material overnight

No material headline, filing, or outsized move for ASTS, TMC, critical minerals, or space/spectrum overnight.

## What actually matters this morning

- Wednesday FOMC decision and Powell presser (hold expected; language on growth vs inflation).
- Thursday 08:30 GDP advance + PCE cluster as post-FOMC confirmation.
- Yields easing slightly into the meeting with positive curve.
- ASTS estimated earnings November 9; no dated launch this week.
- TMC estimated earnings November 12; insider activity quiet.
